abstract_sentences.text: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) laid the foundation for sequence modeling, but their intrinsic sequential nature restricts parallel computation, creating a fundamental barrier to scaling.

evidence.anchor: intrinsic sequential nature restricts parallel computation

abstract_sentences.text: This has led to the dominance of parallelizable architectures like Transformers and, more recently, State Space Models (SSMs).

evidence.anchor: dominance of parallelizable architectures

abstract_sentences.text: While SSMs achieve efficient parallelization through structured linear recurrences, this linearity constraint limits their expressive power and precludes modeling complex, nonlinear sequence-wise dependencies.

evidence.anchor: linearity constraint limits their expressive power

abstract_sentences.text: To address this, we present ParaRNN, a framework that breaks the sequence-parallelization barrier for nonlinear RNNs.

evidence.anchor: framework that breaks the sequence-parallelization barrier

abstract_sentences.text: Building on prior work, we cast the sequence of nonlinear recurrence relationships as a single system of equations, which we solve in parallel using Newton’s iterations combined with custom parallel reductions.

evidence.anchor: single system of equations

abstract_sentences.text: Our implementation achieves speedups of up to 665× over naïve sequential application, allowing training nonlinear RNNs at unprecedented scales.

evidence.anchor: speedups of up to 665×

abstract_sentences.text: To showcase this, we apply ParaRNN to adaptations of LSTM and GRU architectures, successfully training models of 7B parameters that attain perplexity comparable to similarly-sized Transformers and Mamba2 architectures.

evidence.anchor: models of 7B parameters

abstract_sentences.text: To accelerate research in efficient sequence modeling, we release the ParaRNN codebase as an open-source framework for automatic training-parallelization of nonlinear RNNs, enabling researchers and practitioners to explore new nonlinear RNN models at scale.

evidence.anchor: release the ParaRNN codebase as an open-source framework

introduction_moves.move: context：Transformer 通过 attention 的长度维并行取代 RNN，留下经典 RNN cell application 必须顺序展开的问题。

evidence.anchor: attention mechanism, can in fact be applied in parallel

introduction_moves.move: problem：RNN 具有较小 memory footprint 和较高 inference efficiency，因此重新受到关注，但训练并行性仍限制规模化序列建模。

evidence.anchor: whose application must be unrolled sequentially

introduction_moves.move: context/problem：Mamba 等 SSM 以纯线性 hidden-state recurrence 获得 associativity 和 parallel reduction，回应训练速度问题。

evidence.anchor: purely linear in the hidden state

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work：线性约束损害 expressive power，且被作者描述为并行化必要性带来的代价。

evidence.anchor: dictated by necessity rather than choice

introduction_moves.move: missing_insight：ParaRNN 把长度为 L 的顺序应用改写为 L 个非线性方程的系统，把问题转成快速求解该系统。

evidence.anchor: re-casting the sequential application of an RNN

introduction_moves.move: method_preview：Newton linearization 暴露 block bi-diagonal structure，再以 custom parallel reductions 求解，指向 §2。

evidence.anchor: block bi-diagonal structure

introduction_moves.move: method_preview：代码只要求 recurrence formula 并自动完成 sequence-parallel application，指向 §4 和 Appendix D。

evidence.anchor: relying only on the definition of the RNN recurrence formula

introduction_moves.move: result_preview：适配 LSTM/GRU，并与 Transformer、Mamba 比较 runtime 和 language-model effectiveness，指向 §3 和 §5。

evidence.anchor: compare their performance against the Transformer and Mamba architectures

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list：三项贡献分别落在 reduction algorithm、7B nonlinear RNN language modeling、PyTorch+CUDA library。

evidence.anchor: our main contributions can be listed as follows

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + nearest_neighbor_contrast：并行 RNN/SSM 谱系通向 Mamba/Mamba2，parallel scan 的 associativity 同时制造 linearity/expressivity gap。

evidence.anchor: associativity of linear operations enables then the use of parallel scan

related_work_moves.move: limitation_of_prior + nearest_neighbor_contrast + credit_or_foundation：比较 minGRU/minLSTM、xLSTM、zero-order、ODE time-parallelization、DeepPCR、Lim/Gonzalez；指出 quasi-Newton 近似 backward 的代价。

evidence.anchor: requires approximating the backward pass as well

related_work_moves.move: positioning_only：以 Jacobi、Gauss-Seidel、Picard 的其他顺序操作并行化收尾，未将这些 solver 纳入实验基线。

evidence.anchor: some looser connections with other approaches

method_moves.move: setup_notation：定义输入序列、hidden state、零初值和 recurrence step Eq. (1)。

evidence.anchor: hidden state hl through its recurrent application

method_moves.move: state_problem：把所有 recurrence relations 合并为 L 个未知 hidden states 的 Eq. (2) 方程组。

evidence.anchor: define a single system of L equations

method_moves.move: derive：Newton 在第 k 次迭代线性化方程组，形成 Eq. (3) 的 block bi-diagonal system。

evidence.anchor: solving its linearization

method_moves.move: define_component：用 Jacobian 和 residual 解释线性化系统及更新量。

evidence.anchor: Jacobian of the recurrence step

method_moves.move: contrast_alternative：说明 forward substitution 可顺序求解，却会抵消并行化收益。

evidence.anchor: this would defeat the purpose of parallelization

method_moves.move: derive：Eq. (4) 与 Eq. (5) 展开 Jacobian product/residual sum，利用 matrix multiplication associativity 暴露 prefix-sum 结构。

evidence.anchor: leveraging associativity of matrix multiplication

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm：Algorithm 1a 用 Newton 作 outer solver，Algorithm 1b 用 parallel reduction 作 inner solver。

evidence.anchor: Newton’s method as outer solver

method_moves.move: state_complexity：parallel reduction 以 O(log_2 L) steps 计算整段更新，dense 矩阵代价在 §2.1 展开。

evidence.anchor: in O(log2 L) steps, rather than sequentially in O(L) steps

method_moves.move: connect_to_prediction：线性 SSM 的 Jacobian 退化为 state transition matrix，Newton 一轮即为 vanilla SSM application。

evidence.anchor: target output is recovered in a single iteration

method_moves.move: derive：backward recurrence Eq. (6) 是线性反向展开，可复用 parallel reduction，不需要 Newton。

evidence.anchor: the backward pass through an RNN cell is an inherently linear operation

method_moves.move: state_problem → define_component：选择直接调整 cell 定义，使真实 Jacobian 具有可存储、可相乘的结构。

evidence.anchor: directly tune the RNN definition

method_moves.move: define_component：给出含 peephole/combined gates 的 GRU、LSTM recurrence Eq. (7a)–(7b)，并定义 LSTM 的二变量状态。

evidence.anchor: the hidden state is given by the collation of two variables

method_moves.move: derive：Eq. (8a)–(8b) 计算 GRU 与 LSTM Jacobian，解释 LSTM 2×2 sub-Jacobian 的偏导含义。

evidence.anchor: each sub-Jacobian indicates the partial derivative

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism：Eq. (9) 将 A_*、C_* 设为 diagonal，得到 GRU diagonal 与 LSTM diagonal-block Jacobians，内存 O(Ld_h)、乘法 O(d_h)。

evidence.anchor: each pairwise multiplication can be performed with O(dh) complexity

method_moves.move: connect_to_prediction：同一结构抑制 hidden-state component mixing，预示 expressivity trade-off，并在 §5.2 以 synthetic tasks 检验。

evidence.anchor: inhibiting any mixing of the hidden state components

method_moves.move: contrast_alternative：其他 Jacobian shapes 只要保持高效 reduction 即可接入，Householder 等结构留给未来。

evidence.anchor: Alternative Jacobian shapes can be accommodated

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm：软件以 RNN cell、implementation、application modality 分层，autograd 自动装配，并提供 Pure PyTorch、CUDA、Fully-fused 三档。

evidence.anchor: three different implementations of the parallel solver

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism：CUDA 在 thread、warp、block、grid/device 层级混合 forward substitution 与 parallel reduction，匹配 GPU memory hierarchy。

evidence.anchor: mirroring this hierarchy

method_moves.move: connect_to_experiment：正文比较实现与 Mamba，Appendix D.3 给出从 recurrence step 到 CUDA specialization 的 ParaGRU 示例。

evidence.anchor: reference implementation for the ParaGRU and ParaLSTM cells

claim_closure.claim: ParaRNN enables sequence-parallel training of nonlinear RNN applications.
claim_closure.origin: Introduction contribution 1 and method preview, p.2.
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (1)–(5) recast the recurrence, Newton linearizes it, and Algorithm 1 solves the structured system by parallel reduction.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 2 measures parallel reduction and full forward timing; Figure 5 expands modalities.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 states that the training-parallelization barrier is overcome at scale.

evidence.anchor: unlocking parallelization also for nonlinear RNNs
parallel reduction ... inner solver
full Newton routine

claim_closure.claim: Classical nonlinear RNNs can be trained at 7B with competitive language-model performance.
claim_closure.method_response: ParaGRU and ParaLSTM combine diagonal or block-diagonal Jacobians with the shared language-model block.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2 reports 7B PPL and downstream scores, while Table 6 adds four scales; Mamba2 remains strongest on PPL and only two adapted cells are tested.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 calls nonlinear RNNs a viable alternative after the computational barrier is removed.

evidence.anchor: models of 7B parameters
Mamba2 achieves the strongest performance
consistent across different parameter counts

claim_closure.claim: The framework supports efficient reductions and competitive runtime against Mamba.
claim_closure.origin: Introduction contribution 1 and result preview, p.2.
claim_closure.method_response: The reduction solver and three implementation modes expose the speed/programmability trade-off.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 2, 3, 5, and 6 report reduction, forward, inference, and backward timings with explicit hardware protocols.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 says the code delivers performance matching or exceeding existing parallel implementations.

evidence.anchor: runtime equivalent to the Mamba SSM application
throughput of ∼ 37−38 tokens per second
matches or exceeds existing parallel implementations

claim_closure.claim: ParaRNN can automate sequence-parallelization from a recurrence-step specification.
claim_closure.origin: Introduction contribution 3 and code preview, p.2.
claim_closure.method_response: BaseRNNCell/RNNCellImpl uses autograd and structure specializations; D.3 shows the minimum recurrence implementation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Appendix D.1–D.4 documents interfaces and extensions, but dense Jacobians cannot use the provided CUDA reduction and fused mode needs cell-specific CUDA code.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 recalls the codebase as available to practitioners.

claim_closure.claim: Nonlinearities supply expressivity that linear RNNs lack on relevant sequence tasks.
claim_closure.method_response: The adapted nonlinear GRU/LSTM cells are evaluated alongside linear Mamba2, with a full-Jacobian control.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 supports the claim on most tasks, but A5 remains weak and the single-layer suite is limited.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 uses the result to motivate further exploration rather than to claim universal expressivity.

evidence.anchor: nonlinear RNNs provide computational expressivity

final_judgment.single_storyline: ParaRNN 将长度 L 的非线性 recurrence 改写为方程组，以 Newton linearization 暴露 block bi-diagonal system，再用结构化 parallel reduction 和 CUDA hierarchy 实现 sequence-parallel forward/backward；diagonal/block-diagonal GRU/LSTM 使该机制进入 7B language-model training。[p.3–8，§2–5]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (1)–(9)、Algorithm 1、Figures 1–3 和 Tables 1–2，分别承担求解逻辑、细胞结构、runtime、expressivity 和 7B language-model decision。[p.3–10，§2–5]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 收敛、完整 timing modalities、chunk-size、throughput/memory scaling、训练配置、任务定义和软件代码移入 Appendix A–D；方法方向和 headline decision 在正文自足，复现粒度与边界依赖附录。[p.15–31，Appendix A–D]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 把每个方法选择绑定到可观测后果。Eq. (9) 同时解释 O(Ld_h) 成本并预测 A5 退化，Figure 2 对齐 solver implementation 与 sequence length，Table 1 并列 nonlinear expressivity 和 full-Jacobian control。[p.6、p.8–9]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 快速 Newton convergence 缺少 arbitrary cell 的理论条件，7B 竞争性只覆盖两种 adapted cell、单一 SlimPajama 流程和 point estimates；runtime 还使用简化 Mamba module 与 minimum timing，因此「任意 nonlinear cell」和广义「competitive at scale」需保持范围限定。[p.5、p.9–10、p.17]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把并行化假设、结构化表示和代价放进方法段，让同一结构在主文结果中产生可证伪预测；失败任务和不利 baseline 保留在主文。[p.5–6、p.9，§2.1、§3、Table 1]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于 Markovian recurrence、可高效表示的 Jacobian、以及在小常数 Newton iterations 下稳定的 cell；dense Jacobian、未知收敛行为和其他 GPU/数据/训练协议需要另行验证。[p.5、p.7、p.15–16、p.31]
